stories.title: The Underwater Secret
stories.intro: Follow Aktapokus on his first big adventure deep in the ocean!

cards.title: A Little Octopus
text: He is yellow and very cute.
He lives deep in the ocean.

cards.title: Six Arms
text: He is different from the others.

cards.title: An Explorer
text: Every day, he swims to new places.
He wants to see the whole ocean.

cards.title: Something Strange
text: One morning, Aktapokus swims very deep.

cards.title: The Spaceship
text: There is a door, and the door is open.

cards.title: The Digital Lens
text: He sees a strange digital lens.

cards.title: A New Adventure
text: The digital lens shines at Aktapokus.
A small screen says: HELLO, EXPLORER.

cards.title: BEEP!
text: The digital lens shines at Aktapokus.
The lens jumps onto his glasses!

cards.title: Words!
text: A word comes into his red lens: ARM.

cards.title: Hello, Fish!
text: A small fish swims near him.

cards.title: Everything
text: He looks at a shell and a rock.
The red lens knows every name.
It knows the sea and the sky.

cards.title: A Superpower
text: "I can see. I can learn. I can know!"
Aktapokus is not a little octopus now.

cards.title: Home
text: His mum and dad are there.

cards.title: Science
text: Dad looks at the red lens.

cards.title: Up There
text: There is a bright star in the sky.
"What is up there? I want to know!"

questions.q: What colour is the new lens?
How many arms has Aktapokus got?
